_comment: 26.1.0-rc.10 ships Windows first, and is the first public build since rc.4 (rc.5 through rc.9 were local only). The installer is self-signed (real Authenticode signature + timestamp; untrusted self-signed chain, so SmartScreen still warns). No macOS entry yet: the rc.3 onward DMGs are all pending; Kevin adds the macos platform block when one is built. Mac testers stay on the still-hosted rc.2 DMG until then.
